newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soymeal weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soymeal weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA soymeal export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net sales of 19,200 MT were mainly the result of increases for Venezuela (12,500 MT) and Canada (4,900 MT) being partially offset by reductions for Australia (8,000 MT, switched to 1997/98).
Sales activity for the 1997/98 marketing year of 92,700 MT were mainly for unknown destinations (60,000 MT) and Australia (18,000 MT).
Exports of 34,300 MT were 26 percent less than the previous week and 46 percent below the 4-week average. Venezuela (16,700 MT) and Colombia (6,600 MT) were the major recipients.
